# The Well Electrical Trading

> 100% African female-owned electrical contractor based in Kraaifontein, Cape Town, South Africa. Founder: Mbali Zondo. The Well Trading delivers certified electrical installations, solar backup power systems, Certificates of Compliance (COC), cable reticulation, generator installations, refrigeration and air-conditioning, and building services across Cape Town and the Western Cape.

The company is registered and compliant, with all work certified to South African electrical standards (SANS 10142). Contact: +27 73 142 9278 (phone and WhatsApp) or admin@thewelltrading.co.za. Physical address: 10 Camberely Crescent, Buh Rein Estate, Kraaifontein, 7570, Western Cape, South Africa.

## Services

- [Electrical Installations](https://thewelltrading.co.za/services/#electrical): domestic and commercial wiring, distribution boards, lighting and power points
- [Solar Backup Power](https://thewelltrading.co.za/services/#solar): inverter and battery backup systems that keep homes and businesses running through load shedding
- [Certificates of Compliance (COC)](https://thewelltrading.co.za/services/#coc): single-phase and three-phase COC issuance, inspections and corrections
- [Cable Reticulation](https://thewelltrading.co.za/services/#cable-reticulation): underground and surface cable routes for estates and developments
- [Generator Installations](https://thewelltrading.co.za/services/#generators): standby generator supply, changeover switches and commissioning
- [Refrigeration & Air-Conditioning](https://thewelltrading.co.za/services/#refrigeration): fridge and freezer repairs, HVAC installation and servicing
- [Building Services](https://thewelltrading.co.za/services/#building): electrical-focused renovations, additions and project coordination
